note: Scale-free companions. e_norm = |y_true-y_pred| / SD_p(y_true), SD_p the within-pair SD of the observed target on that fold, pairs with n<10 or SD=0 dropped. sigma_norm = sigma_total / SD_p. Fold-level first, then fold mean +/- SD (ddof=1). Frozen fold scores only; no retraining. NOTE: the eligible subsample differs from the unnormalised tables because of the n>=10 / SD>0 filter.
